name: MatchMaker
description:
Class matching pair of ids to return pre-defined (for a pair of ids defined in matches<MatchMaker.matches>) or derived value (computed using algo<MatchMaker.algo>) of a scalar parameter. It can be called (``id1``, ``id2``, ``val1=NaN``, ``val2=NaN``) in both python and c++.
